text: And Moses{H4872} went up{H5927} from the plains{H6160} of Moab{H4124} unto mount{H2022} Nebo,{H5015} to the top{H7218} of Pisgah,{H6449} that is over against{H6440} Jericho.{H3405} And Jehovah{H3068} showed{H7200} him all the land{H776} of Gilead,{H1568} unto Dan,{H1835}
